author: Mark Atwood
text:
Probe executed. Outcome: no propagation needed.

**Audit procedure** (per bead body): for each of the 7 extension-server crates (mail, chat, contacts, calendars, tasks, filenode, sharing), ran:

  rg 'tracing::(trace|debug|info|warn|error)' crate-jmap-<crate>/src/

**Result**: zero matches in any of the 7 crates. None of them emits any tracing::* event today.

**Cross-check**: also confirmed metadata-server's own src/ has zero tracing::* calls — its tests/common/log_capture.rs + tests/log_redaction.rs is a forward-compat tripwire installed pre-emptively (the test file's own rustdoc cites this verbatim: 'The crate currently emits zero tracing::* events (verified by ...).').

**Conclusion**: the workspace's current extension-server crates do not need log_capture.rs canaries. The two crates that do have them (jmap-base-client and jmap-metadata-server) are sufficient — base-client is the canonical credentials boundary and metadata-server's canary is the forward-compat installation that the bead's expected outcome correctly anticipated.

**Follow-up**: when any extension-server crate adds its first tracing::* event that interpolates a Debug-bearing argument, the contributor MUST add the matching canary in the same commit per the workspace AGENTS.md 'Security testing' rule. No sweep bead needed today.

Closing as probe-complete, no propagation.
